verdict.rationale: LightSprint's engineering page says it analyzes codebase reliability, security and velocity, and gives recommendations you can turn into tasks from one panel. That is in-product insight and suggestion from the user's own data. Supporting signals are a Merge Readiness score and plain-English summaries of changes for reviewers. However, the evidence is a single marketing line: it does not say the recommendations are AI-generated, what data they cover beyond code, or how deep they go. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of the insights/recommendations panel, explicit confirmation that suggestions are AI-generated, insights on data beyond the codebase and delivery metrics, independent or hands-on corroboration.
